company.name: CapyGroup
company.shortDescription: CapyGroup is a fintech platform that provides instant payout and embedded financial solutions.
company.description: CapyGroup is an embedded finance and payout infrastructure company focused on the performance marketing ecosystem. The company offers financial products tailored for affiliates, influencers, publishers, networks, and app developers who often face long payment cycles. Its solutions include instant payouts, multi-currency transfers, revenue-based funding, working capital access, and flexible withdrawal methods such as bank transfers, PayPal, Payoneer, and cryptocurrency wallets. CapyGroup aims to bridge the gap between fintech and MarTech by enabling faster cash flow, reducing payout delays, and supporting global digital businesses with scalable financial infrastructure. The company has also partnered with performance marketing platforms to expand real-time cross-border payment capabilities and liquidity solutions.
